detailZones.title: Medicine shelves
detailZones.description: Glass shelves hold rows of cartons, white bottles and small glass vials. A strip of light runs beneath the lowest shelf.

detailZones.title: Counting tray and basket
detailZones.description: White tablets lie on a blue counting tray. A white basket and an amber bottle sit to its left.

detailZones.title: Mortar, cylinder and ampoules
detailZones.description: A white pestle rests in a mortar beside a tall graduated cylinder. Clear and amber ampoules stand in a white holder to the right.

detailZones.title: Drawers and open shelves
detailZones.description: A metal pull spans the face of a wooden drawer. The open cupboard beside it contains glass shelves, cartons and a white basket.

detailZones.title: Service window and terminal
detailZones.description: A touchscreen terminal stands beside a metal-framed opening. A white tray sits on its sill.

detailZones.title: Refrigerator and dispensing cabinet
detailZones.description: A lit glass-fronted refrigerator stands next to a narrow bank of metal drawers with a blue display.

detailZones.title: Pharmacy supply cart
detailZones.description: Three metal shelves on a wheeled frame carry a tray of bottles, a blue bin and a transparent box.
